features: Futuristic Transparent Design – Elevate your setup with a premium transparent body that showcases the internal components, giving this wireless mouse a tech-savvy and modern aesthetic.
Dual Wireless Connectivity – Enjoy seamless switching between devices with Bluetooth 5.3 and 2.4GHz wireless support—perfect for work, study, or gaming across laptops, PCs, and tablets.
Rechargeable Battery Built-In – No more battery replacements! The Toad 8 wireless mouse features a rechargeable battery that delivers long-lasting performance with fast Type-C charging.
Multi-Device & Pair Enabled – Easily pair with multiple devices and toggle effortlessly using built-in switching, making this mouse ideal for multitaskers.
Precision at Your Fingertips – Adjust DPI sensitivity up to 1600 for smooth, responsive tracking whether you’re scrolling documents or editing designs.
Silent Click Functionality – Experience quiet productivity with noise-free clicking that keeps you focused in shared or silent workspaces.
Quick Access Desktop Button – Includes a convenient Show/Hide desktop button for instant workspace decluttering and efficient multitasking.
